_about: THE WEAPONS SAY WHAT THEY DO (rule 75e, Paolo 10/5: 'weapons that I don't even think you know what they're supposed to do yet'). One plain line per Battle Brothers weapon class, the name it carries in Bohemia and its base named, read by the fight's weapon card (hold a finger on the strike square or on a man) and by RUN TWO's market. Our seven jobs are WORDS' lines; the eight classes the enemy carries are COMBAT's drafts for WORDS. Every weapon in weapons.json has its class here (THE REBUILT FIGHT PLAYS gate). A modder edits this file.

dagger.name: PISTOL
dagger.line: A cheap handgun. Light and quick, but armor barely feels it.

firearm.name: SHOTGUN
firearm.line: One huge hit point-blank, then a slow reload.

crossbow.name: RIFLE
crossbow.line: Hits from across the street. You pay for the range with a reload between shots.

mace.name: PIPE
mace.line: Dumb, heavy, and it crushes straight through armor.

hammer.name: SLEDGE
hammer.line: The heaviest thing you can swing. Armor does not help against it.

throwing.name: BOTTLES
throwing.line: Thrown, not swung. It reaches past a pipe, and you only carry a few.

shield.name: CAR DOOR
shield.line: You do not swing it. You hide behind it, and you can shove a man back with it.

sword.name: BLADE
sword.line: A long blade. The easiest swing to land, but armor slows it down.
sword.by: COMBAT 10/5 [weapons say what they do], a draft for WORDS from the class's weapons.json numbers and its Battle Brothers skills (MECHANISM-MINE, 8/11: every player-facing word ships as an attempt)
sword.why: swords: 16 rows, 47-58 damage, 81% to armour; Slash +10% to hit (bb_all Slash)

cleaver.name: CLEAVER
cleaver.line: A butcher's chopper. It leaves a man bleeding and finishes the wounded.
cleaver.by: COMBAT 10/5 [weapons say what they do], a draft for WORDS from the class's weapons.json numbers and its Battle Brothers skills (MECHANISM-MINE, 8/11: every player-facing word ships as an attempt)
cleaver.why: cleavers: 14 rows, 36-53 damage; Cleave bleeds, Decapitate on the hurt

axe.name: AXE
axe.line: Big hits that chew through armor and split a car door in two.

polearm.name: POLE
polearm.line: Hits from the second row, over your own man's shoulder. Slow to swing.

throwable_item.name: KIT
throwable_item.line: Not a weapon. A net, a fire pot or a flask you throw to change the fight.
